articles.title: Is Keller Group (LSE:KLR) Still Undervalued After Its 306% Run?
articles.summary: Keller Group has delivered a striking share price run over the past few years, and the question now is whether the current £29.74 level can be backed up by the cash the business is expected to generate. With a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate available, the focus turns to how those projected cash flows stack up against what the market is already paying.
